# Study 3a — Joint inference over desire and effort (non-food)

Study 1b's design on the non-food stimulus set: the observer jointly infers
desire and effort from a single observed action, given intimacy. Each trial has
two slider responses.

**Status:** Full sample is in `data/nonfood_inv_joint_de/` (recruited and
retained counts are reported by the demographics chunk below). This document
reports demographics and data checks only — all figures (the joint
belief-update panels and the model-vs-human panels) are generated in Python by
`figures/scripts/figure_study3.py` and `figures/scripts/figure_model_scatter.py`
(`make figures-results`), and the model-comparison statistics by
`model/cv/model_comparison.py` (`make model-comparison`).

## Demographics

```{r demographics}
if (file.exists(here::here("data", "nonfood_inv_joint_de", "exit_survey.csv"))) {
```

## Data

```{r load-data}
data_path <- here::here("data", "nonfood_inv_joint_de", "main_trials_long.csv")
have_data <- file.exists(data_path)
if (have_data) {
  df <- read_csv(data_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cat("Trials:", nrow(df), "\n")
  glimpse(df)
} else {
  cat("No data yet for nonfood_inv_joint_de.\n")
}
```
